current.text: He is a rookie guard. The Rockets took him 31st, the first pick of the second round, after four years of college.
In Summer League he averaged 16 points, more than 2.5 steals and 4 assists, and shot 41% from three.
He could make some impact from opening night as extra guard depth.
Lloyd thinks he might become a real NBA player.
The Houston guard rotation is crowded with Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Reed Sheppard. That limits his path to minutes.
Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes and gives little room for error to players who struggle on defense. This caps the role of a bench rookie.

durable.text: His shooting numbers are elite across the board.
He is undersized for an NBA guard.
